hook.text: Mark Zuckerberg donated $45 billion to charity in 2015. He also got a massive tax break for doing it.

buildup.text: Charitable donations are tax-deductible. Give $1 million to a foundation and your tax bill drops.

discovery.text: Donor-advised funds let people claim the deduction now but distribute money to charity much later—or never.

twist.text: Some donate appreciated stock instead of cash. They avoid capital gains tax and get the full deduction.

climax.text: Philanthropy subsidized by taxpayers means the public funds rich people's chosen causes.

punchline.text: Charity shouldn't need a tax incentive.

quiz.question: What is a donor-advised fund?
options: A way to claim deductions now but donate later
A fund that advises donors on investments
